old_value: {"id":"mimid-1wgh.37.98","title":"wg: protocol-07 §5.10.3 OHTTP download is not implementable as written (no gateway discovery, no key config, cut-off sentence)","description":"Found 2026-11-16 sizing bead mimid-1wgh.8 (the hub 'MUST' implement an OHTTP Gateway, §5.10.3 txt ~L2830-2880). Proposal: add 'ohttpGateway' and 'ohttpKeys' directory entries, or reference RFC 9540 (OHTTP key discovery via SVCB). mimid implements §5.10.2 proxyDownload (b18f01e) and holds off on OHTTP until this is settled.
